justification: JavaSymbolSolver class is excessively large with 500+ lines of code, contains 20+ conditional branches for different node types, implements multiple complex responsibilities including type resolution, declaration resolution, and parameter resolution, and has three large private helper methods. The class acts as a central hub coordinating multiple subsystems, exhibiting clear God Component characteristics.

The package contains 15 classes with significant code duplication and large class sizes. Multiple classes exceed 500 lines of code (e.g., MethodRebaseResolver, RebaseDynamicTypeBuilder, AbstractInliningDynamicTypeBuilder, DecoratingDynamicTypeBuilder), and several classes are repeated verbatim (MethodRebaseResolver and its inner classes appear multiple times). The package handles complex responsibilities including method rebasing, type redefinition, and dynamic type building, indicating excessive functionality concentration.

The package contains 28 classes, many of which are excessively large in lines of code. The Gson class alone is over 1000 lines, and other classes like JsonArray, JsonElement, and TypeAdapter are also very large. The package centralizes core JSON processing functionality, handling serialization, deserialization, type adaptation, and configuration across numerous classes, making it excessively large in both lines of code and number of classes.

The package contains 28 classes with extensive functionality for multiple 1D barcode formats (UPC/EAN, Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, ITF, Codabar, RSS), including both readers and writers. Several classes exceed 200+ lines of code (Code39Reader: 300+, Code128Writer: 500+, Code128Reader: 400+), and the package handles numerous responsibilities across different barcode standards in a single package.

The package contains 21 classes with excessive total lines of code, including extremely large classes like ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory (over 1000 lines) and TypeAdapters (over 1000 lines). Multiple classes exceed 500 lines, and there are duplicate class definitions (MapTypeAdapterFactory.Adapter, CollectionTypeAdapterFactory.Adapter, TreeTypeAdapter.SingleTypeFactory, TreeTypeAdapter.GsonContextImpl, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.FieldsData, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.BoundField, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.Adapter, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.FieldReflectionAdapter, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.RecordAdapter, TypeAdapters.IntegerFieldsTypeAdapter, TypeAdapters.FactorySupplier, JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactory.DummyTypeAdapterFactory) indicating code duplication and maintenance issues.
